about.service_description: Countries provides 249 embedded ISO 3166-1 records through public REST and GraphQL endpoints and server-rendered pages. Records include names, ISO codes, capitals, region, currencies, languages, population and observation year where available, area, flags, borders, time zones, top-level domains, and representative coordinates.
about.feature_search: Search country names and filter by code, region, currency, or language
about.feature_lookup: Look up records by alpha-2, alpha-3, or numeric country code
about.feature_nearest: Find the nearest country centroid or countries within a radius
about.feature_api: Read country records through REST or GraphQL
about.attribution.country_data: Country names, codes, capitals, regions, currencies, languages, area, coordinates, borders, and top-level domains use mledoze/countries data under the Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL).
about.attribution.population: 2024 population values are from the World Bank World Development Indicators, indicator SP.POP.TOTL, under CC BY 4.0.
about.attribution.timezones: Time zone identifiers are from the IANA time zone database (tzdb) and are public domain.
about.attribution.flags: The application links to flag-icons SVG assets served by flagcdn.io; those assets are MIT licensed and are not embedded in the binary.
about.attribution.sources: Full source versions, field provenance, and license notices: https://github.com/apimgr/countries/blob/main/src/data/README.md

help.description: Find country data, API documentation, and answers to common questions.
help.search_content: Search country names at /search or query the API with GET /api/v1/countries/search?q=united. Narrow results with code, region, currency, or language filters. Look up a country by alpha-2, alpha-3, or numeric code at GET /api/v1/countries/US.
help.coordinates_content: Find the country with the nearest representative coordinate using GET /api/v1/coordinates?lat=40.7&lon=-74.0. Nearby results accept a radius in kilometers at GET /api/v1/nearby?lat=40.7&lon=-74.0&radius=500.
help.cli_content: Use countries-cli list, get US, search united, nearest 40.7 -74.0, nearby 40.7 -74.0 500, or stats. Run countries-cli --help for the current flags and output formats.
help.faq.no_auth: The public API is read-only and does not require an API key.
help.faq.static_data: Country records are embedded in the server binary. The API does not fetch live population, exchange-rate, or political data.
help.faq.population: Population values include an observation year when available. Missing source observations are omitted rather than estimated.
help.faq.rate_limit: A 429 response means the deployment request limit was reached. Wait for the Retry-After interval before retrying.
help.configuration_content: Operators configure the server through server.yml. This service has no account system or web administration panel.

help.mcp.overview: This is a remote-only MCP server over Streamable HTTP. It exposes this project's operations as tools; every request requires a bearer token, and the token's scope determines which tools are available.

privacy.data_collection_content:
**We collect only what is necessary to provide our service:**

**Usage Information (with consent):**
- Pages visited and features used
- Browser type and device information
- Approximate location (country/region from IP, not precise)

**Technical Information:**
- IP address (for security and abuse prevention)
- API token identifiers (hashed, never stored in plain text)

**We do NOT collect:**
- Payment information (unless explicitly required by the service)
- Precise location data
- Data from other websites or apps
privacy.data_usage_content:
**Your data is used solely to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news

**Your data is NEVER:**
- Sold to third parties
- Used for targeted advertising
- Shared without your explicit consent (except as required by law)
privacy.data_usage_if_sold_content:
**Your data may be used to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news
- **Third-party sharing:** Your data may be shared with or sold to third parties for analytics, advertising, or other purposes as described below

**Your rights:**
- You can opt out of data sales with the CCPA opt-out on the preferences page (`/server/preferences`)
- You can delete the resources you created at any time with your owner token, and request deletion of other data through the contact details on the privacy page
- See "Your Rights" section below for details
privacy.data_security_content:
**How we protect your data:**

- All data is stored on our servers (not third-party cloud services unless specified)
- API tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes (never in plain text)
- All connections are encrypted (HTTPS/TLS)
- Regular security audits and updates
- Access controls and audit logging for operator actions
